summary_en: 120,000 shares (4.15% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via N-NET3 off-exchange block trade on 15 Jul 2026 at ¥1,815/share, within ¥240M upper limit. Single-day execution window, 08:45 JST. Acquisition contingent on matching sell orders; partial or full non-execution possible.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via N-NET3 off-exchange block trade
translation_en_brief:
On 14 July 2026, Fuji Seiko's board approved acquisition of treasury shares under Company Law Article 156 (as applied via Article 165(3)). The company announced specific execution parameters for an N-NET3 off-exchange block trade on 15 July 2026 at 08:45 JST using the closing price of ¥1,815/share (inclusive of final quotation) on 14 July.

The buyback is structured as a single-day block trade with an upper limit of 120,000 shares (4.15% of outstanding shares excluding treasury) and ¥240 million aggregate consideration. Execution is contingent on matching sell orders placed at the specified time; the company has stated that partial or complete non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. Acquisition results will be disclosed immediately after the 08:45 trading window closes.
